_comment: Credential fields for the Google Drive OAuth (installed-app / desktop client) flow, resolved via tools/lib/resolve-credential.cjs. Field keys double as the default env var names. opVault/opItem below are the shipped defaults for this tool's own 1Password item -- override the vault/item this tool targets via the GDRIVE_OP_VAULT / GDRIVE_OP_ITEM env vars (see config.js) without editing this file.

GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.description: OAuth 2.0 Desktop client ID (Google Cloud Console -> Credentials).

GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET.description: OAuth 2.0 Desktop client secret, paired with the client ID above.

GOOGLE_OAUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN.description: Long-lived refresh token minted once via authorize.js (offline access, prompt=consent).
